title: Prefrontal activity carries specific perceptual content

statements.text: Multivariate fMRI decoding and single-unit recordings in monkeys show that prefrontal activity reflects specific perceptual content and decisions. Univariate fMRI is too insensitive to show it, and the impression otherwise comes from a selective reading of that literature.

sources.quote: But importantly, the claim that PFC activity does not reflect specific perceptual content is also empirically false.
